heading: Where your money goes
intro: PYT is a nonprofit organization that relies on donations. Participation fees cover 80% of operating costs, the rest comes from the generosity of individuals, families, and corporate sponsors. Here's an idea of some of the costs covered by donations and sponsorships.

items.description: The cost of a scholarship for one actor for a Center Stage Musical.
The cost of a scholarship for one actor to go to summer camp.
The cost of costumes for a Center Stage Musical.
The cost of royalties costs for a Center Stage Musical.
The cost of one month's rent for studio and rehearsal space.
The cost of theater rental for a Center Stage Musical.
